en.quote: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
en.riddle: Now let me die, since I have seen thy face
en.speaker: Israel

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יוֹסֵף אָמוּתָה הַפָּעַם אַחֲרֵי רְאוֹתִי אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ כִּי עוֹדְךָ חָֽי
he.speaker: יִשְׂרָאֵל
